g.text: Choose enough process for the task
User confirms the tickets and their numbered criteria
Reproduce each finding, fix its cause, check the change since the review.
Max 2 rounds per ticket; then the user decides.
Link the run after it starts
Post-integration repair: new ticket, session and worktree from the latest integration tip.
Retro suggests improvements; the user decides. Decisions do not delay archive. Invoke anytime.
A re-review checks only the previous findings, the acceptance commands and the change since.
